verdict.rationale: CSC documents same-day scanning and electronic delivery of service-of-process documents, time-stamped and routed to designated contacts per routing preferences, rather than waiting on a mail batch. Its documented email alerts apply to compliance-calendar and good-standing events, not SOP, so they are not credited here. Missing for 10: an explicit SOP-specific alert mechanism (e.g. email/SMS push on receipt), a stated delivery-time guarantee beyond 'same-day', and independent or hands-on corroboration.
